title: Vector Model Onboarding & Version-Control Playbook for Reranking and Embeddings
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and automation for onboarding new embedding/reranker variants into the reranking endpoint. Scope: offline evaluation harness, compatibility checks (dim, tokenizer, quantization), shadow and canary rollout automation, automated rollback triggers, and dashboards/alerts for quality and latency regression. This ticket focuses on orchestration, version aliasing, and policy rules — model training sits outside scope.
acceptance_criteria: Offline evaluation pipeline runs for a candidate model and produces NDCG@10, MRR@5, and embedding_similarity_distribution artifacts
Compatibility check prevents onboarding if embedding dimension mismatch or tokenizer/hash changes without migration guide
Shadow traffic orchestration can route 1-10% of production queries to candidate model with logging for per-request comparison
Canary rollout automation supports gradual ramp with automated stop if quality or latency thresholds breached
Built dashboards showing p50/p95 latency, nDCG delta, request-level consistency rate, and memory/GPUMem for candidate vs baseline
Rollback policy triggers when nDCG@10 drops by >1.5% absolute or p95 latency increases by >15% sustained for 10 minutes
tasks: Design offline eval job and dataset selection (relevance test set, synthetic edge-cases)
Implement compatibility validator (dim, dtype, tokenizer hash, KV cache version) as pre-flight check
Integrate shadow traffic router and store candidate/baseline side-by-side metrics
Create canary automation in deployment service with ramp steps and kill-switch
Add alerting rules and dashboards in Console (nDCG delta, rerank_latency_p95, embedding_similarity_shift)
Document playbook and publish runbook with rollback steps and stakeholder contacts
notes: Rationale: Reranking endpoint currently tightly coupled to legacy 768-dim float32 embeddings. New candidate models use 1024 dims and int8/quantized kernels; need transparent onboarding to avoid silent regressions.

Evaluation metrics: primary=nDCG@10 and MRR@5 on production-like holdouts. Secondary=embed_cosine_shift (distribution shift), consistency_rate (fraction of top-1 unchanged), p50/p95 latency, and memory usage per replica.
Rollout policy proposal: shadow 5% for 48h -> canary 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over 48h windows with manual approval gate at 10% if quality delta within tolerance.

Fallback rules: if candidate fails KV cache compatibility (KV version mismatch) then block canary and suggest reencoding migration. If latency p95 > baseline *1.15 for 5m, auto-pause ramp and notify infra on-call.
Quantization note: If candidate uses 4-bit quantization, add explicit accuracy test with re-ranking labels and require nDCG delta < 0.8% before canary.
Model aliasing: support stable aliases (e.g., rerank-stable) pointing to current production variant; onboarding flow should publish a temporary alias rerank-shadow-<date> for observability.
Data retention: shadow logs store side-by-side embeddings and scores for 30 days in S3 with access controls for ML team; do not include raw PII.
Trade-offs discussed: conservative thresholds reduce rollout velocity but minimize user-facing regressions. We prioritize quality over small latency wins on initial onboarding.
Open question: should we support automatic dim-projection layers (learned linear projector) during the transition window? Proposed to prototype separately under ENG-48900.
